name: PixelTransition-TS-TW
title: Pixel Dissolve Transition
blurb: Reveals hidden content by dissolving a pixelated overlay on hover, focus, or…
description: GSAP-animated pixel grid that staggered-displays and hides in random order, transitioning between two content slots. Touch devices trigger on click; desktop uses hover/focus.
use_when: Interactive cards, before/after comparisons, or reveal-on-interact UI patterns where a playful pixel effect enhances…
avoid_when: Performance-critical mobile (GSAP animating 49+ DOM elements), or contexts where motion must be disabled.
a11y: Two content slots with aria-hidden toggling based on state. Focusable via tabIndex and responds to keyboard (Enter/Space on focus).
